summary: Today's briefing focuses on significant legal rulings impacting businesses, particularly in the retail sector, alongside noteworthy financial results from major banks.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court allows Britannia to use ‘no added sugar, no maida, no palm oil’ claim on biscuit packs.
Delhi High Court imposes costs of ₹1 on Niva Bupa for misusing IP jurisdiction to sue influencer.
Delhi High Court quashes SFIO probe into Educomp Solutions.
Shoppers Stop turns profitable in Q2 FY27 as consolidated revenue rises 7% to Rs 1,618 crore.
ICICI Bank reported a net profit of Rs 14,843 crore in Q2 FY27, marking a 20% year-on-year increase.
